تعتصروا (form VIII)
# تَعْتَصِرُوا (taʕtaṣirū) /taʕ.ta.sˤi.ruː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَصَرَ (iʕtaṣara)
# تُعْتَصَرُوا (tuʕtaṣarū) /tuʕ.ta.sˤa.ruː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَصَرَ (iʕtaṣara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
